name: Seek responsibility and take responsibility for your actions
definition: For professional development, you must actively seek out challenging assignments. You must use initiative and sound judgment when trying to accomplish jobs that are not required by your grade.

terms.label: seek responsibility and take responsibility for your actions

rows.situation: When a harder assignment is available
rows.under: Waits to be asked, and stays inside the work your grade already requires.
rows.justRight: Asks for the harder assignment and does it with judgment, not as a stunt.
rows.over: Collects extra work until the jobs you already own slip.

rows.under: Points at the people who executed and keeps the story clean.
rows.justRight: Owns the outcome, including what they did on your order, and names the next fix.
rows.over: Takes all the blame as theater and skips the fix.

rows.under: Removes them so the miss is no longer attached to you.
rows.justRight: Keeps the responsibility, does not hide behind their error, and does not punish them for a miss that started with your call.
rows.over: Shields them from every consequence, including ones that are actually theirs.

rows.situation: When work that needs an owner is sitting there
rows.under: Leaves it because it is not required of your seat.
rows.justRight: Picks it up, or stays until it has an owner, and uses judgment on how far to take it.
rows.over: Takes every unowned thing so you can be the person who seeks responsibility.

rows.under: Takes the credit and leaves the miss for someone else to explain.
rows.justRight: Puts your name on the decision, the miss, and the next step.
rows.over: Writes your name on work you barely touched so you look responsible.
